items.title: 14.10 Potential health risks associated with air pollution (air pollution se sehat ke khatre) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Air pollution insanon ki sehat ke liye bare khatre rakhti hai. Sehat par effects (asar) acute (foran, thori der ke) ya chronic (lambe arse ke) ho sakte hain, aur yeh pollutants ki type aur concentration, exposure ki muddat (kitni der) aur har insaan ki apni weakness (kamzori) par depend hote hain. Bare khatre 14.10.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si chaar cheezein tay karti hain ke gandi hawa kisi shakhs ko kitna nuqsan degi?
blocks.explanation: Pollutant ki type, us ki concentration, insaan kitni der us ke saamne raha (exposure kitni der raha), aur us insaan ki apni weakness (jaise bachche, buzurg, dil ya lungs ke mareez).

items: Sehat ka khatra pollutant ki type, concentration, exposure ki muddat aur insaan ki weakness par depend; effects acute ya chronic.
